items.text: And please get vaccinated if you haven’t already! Cases remain high in Michigan but symptoms are proving to be much milder if you’re vaccinated than if you’re not. Let’s do our part to keep everyone safe and healthy. Find out where you can get yours at https://t.co/eKwFjoQOZm.

“Andy stands with nurses and patients in support of #MedicareForAll, safe staffing in our hospitals, occupational health and safety protections for nurses and other health care workers and much more, and that’s why we’re proud to stand with him.” -Renee Curtis, RN, @NNU VP https://t.co/mXP7u8eSkA

"Andy Levin has fought to cut Pentagon bloat and redirect resources to real security needs like universal healthcare, good jobs and a healthy environment. We’ll be working hard to re-elect him because we need him in DC continuing this critical work.” -Jon Rainwater, @PeaceAction https://t.co/wxRAdQX3ou

Our country NEEDS health care reform, be it through #BuildBackBetter, #MedicareForAll, or any other policy that delivers the type of quality care all Americans deserve. Join me and this grassroots movement and sign if you agree:
https://t.co/s5pUFGKcAy

All people deserve the right to an abortion, no matter what — and we have to look out for those who provide them. Add your name to show your support for the fight to protect the safety of abortion care providers and their patients. https://t.co/jCugPm3uxk

Restrictive laws. Outright bans. Demonization of providers and patients. Reproductive rights are under attack—and I believe strongly that we must elevate and recognize those who provide reproductive health care.
https://t.co/yo0mzlEzYJ

Thanks to @NWLC for joining me in celebrating abortion workers, clinic employees, and volunteers across the country who ensure vital health care in uncertain times. A quick and informative read: 
https://t.co/yHspZ9fj6k

Already this year, Republican lawmakers in 19 states have introduced bills to restrict health care for trans and non-binary youth. As allies, it is our responsibility not just to say the right thing, but to vehemently oppose these measures.

Vaccines and boosters make a HUGE difference! But according to research, only 53 percent of Michigan’s fully vaccinated population has received their booster shot.
https://t.co/RIx01dNhUY

This bill is a fantastic step in the right direction. We must not lose sight of the bigger picture. Millions of people will still struggle to pay for life-saving medication. We must allow Medicare to negotiate fair drug prices, and we must fight to pass #MedicareforAll.

The recently passed law in Oklahoma to criminalize abortion providers highlights how important it is that we pass the #ReproductiveFreedomforAll Initiative on the Michigan ballot in November! Abortion providers & patients deserve protection from these regressive measures.

I was honored to visit the Bowen Senior Center in Pontiac. Folks were most concerned about Rx drugs and health care, and we all agreed that health care is a human right. I'm not afraid to stand up to Big Pharma and the insurance lobby to fight for our seniors and our famlies. https://t.co/Xq3tYPE8Ji

"Andy’s one of those rare across-the-board progressives who thinks strategically and practically about how to transform our world in every area from clean air, water and land to racial justice to human rights to health care for all." — @Bonnie4Congress #MI11 https://t.co/yOOphcn2Pk

I’m a two-time cancer survivor & dad of two kids with chronic illnesses. We got medical bills for tens of thousands of dollars & spent hours on the phone fighting insurance companies. So now I’m championing #MedicareforAll and lower drug costs for all of our families.

I ran for Congress to stop Trump from ripping away health care—and I’m still fighting health insurance corporations as the only candidate in this race who supports #MedicareforAll. I won’t stop fighting until every family has the care they need.

My life’s work has been to build a multiracial movement to take back power for the people, to make working hard really pay, to provide excellent public schools for all our kids, free college, health care & dignified retirement for all #MI11

#MedicareforAll includes comprehensive mental health and substance use treatment. That is so important, especially for our kids today, with so many mental health challenges coming out of the pandemic. I’m staying in the fight for this.

Oakland County needs more childcare & home health workers. I’m fighting to make it happen in Congress by making sure those workers get excellent wages. This will free up so many people, especially women, who left the workforce in the pandemic, to get back to work.

Today I am honoring my mother Vicki Levin. She worked in children’s mental health for decades — she inspired me to fight for investments in quality, accessible, affordable education for all. https://t.co/aISmbnyqqA

#TheJewishVote is for Medicare for All, Green New Deal, fair wages & working conditions, an end to mass incarceration & criminalization of people of color, and human rights & democracy. But AIPAC is going after candidates who share our values. Take action: https://t.co/DCXQf7w0o4

Hi, my name is Andy Levin.
I’m a lifelong labor organizer who’s worked with unions & congress alike to pass groundbreaking pro-union bills while supporting Medicare for All and a Green New Deal. 

Our race is tied—will you give me a follow and join our people-powered campaign?
